entries.label: t3code-chat-composer-stash-merge.patch
entries.summary: Restore prompt-stash dedupe and snapshot keys after composer merges
entries.note:
#4271 and #4394 both reshape ChatComposer around the prompt-stash implementation.
Their assembled replay mangles the NUL-delimited template strings used for image
deduplication and in-flight snapshot identity. Neither topic is broken alone;
this patch restores those three assembly-emergent expressions.

entries.label: t3code-refreshed-client-overlap.patch
entries.summary: Reconcile refreshed client topics after the cumulative settings merge
entries.note:
Assembly-emergent overlap: the cumulative client topic moves settings ownership
and keybindings after #4271, #4277, #4390, #4494, and upstream prompt stash.
Keep the refreshed settings write queue, shortcut defaults, and thread-forking
call sites against that final structure.
